question: On nine source-authenticated VOC intra-island route pairs, do recorded plant commodity categories of seven cargo-supported links align with the known HOSTS genera of butterflies independently first indexed on either or both actual corresponding islands during 2011–2017?

source.voyage: source-locked 1595–1698 57669 rows and nine positive 1193 island-pair sections
source.cargo: voc_17c_cargo_on_verified_island_routes_v1.json (original cargo descriptions 7737 rows; 7/9 routes with unambiguous cargo IDs)
source.cargo_genus: voc_17c_cargo_HOSTS_genus_239_screen_v1.json, 239 preselected Lepidoptera HOSTS genus mapping, only exact complete named butterfly preview accepted
source.gbif_first_island_events: provenance/reviewer_defenses/results/island_host_continuity_20261030/island_host_continuity_events.csv, original indexed first 2011–2017, n=5665 all source islands

primary_stat: number of 7 cargo-supported historic edges with >=1 exact same butterfly species first GBIF-indexed in both endpoint islands 2011–2017 and documented to use a plant genus assigned to one of that edge's cargo commodity categories
secondary_stats: number of edges with at least one local first-index butterfly in either endpoint with compatible documented HOSTS genus
number of edges with at least one such butterfly in EACH endpoint (not necessarily same butterfly or same commodity genus)
number of documented compatible commodity categories among seven links and island butterfly first-indexed events

null.method: EXACT permutation of the seven entire commodity-category sets across seven historically cargo-indexed route edges, preserving island butterfly sets, fixed source route geography, per-route commodity category counts as packets, and total historical category frequencies
null.right_tail_report: (number of all 5040 labeled permutations with statistic >= observed)/5040
null.why_exploratory: route category packets and endpoint butterflies share geographic/historical context, so conditional random exchangeability of cargo among routes is unverified; exact finite label permutation is not independent causal frequentist test

cautions: Commodity descriptions are not scientific species names, live plant propagules or documented cargo specifically loaded/unloaded on that island leg.
The present-day genus-host match can be true globally but unverified as local larval use or plant introduction.
2011–2017 first GBIF indexing is not an actual insect arrival, breeding, persistence or global 2011–2022 population representative sample.
6 islands and 7 nonindependent cargo-supported links: no inference about general global colonial or shipping causal network.
No stock VOC voyage may be assumed to carry butterflies; 17th century vs 21st century temporal gap.
Host-genus screen with full preview names is exact only if reported butterfly totals match the names list length; otherwise HALT, do not assume truncated preview complete.
All nine independently documented historic positive island links and the original 51-island positive ρ=0.300 are retained, not replaced by a selected seven-edge null.
